title: Billing & Contract Daily Log - Liam O'Connor
content:
Daily scratchpad (finance/legal) - quick triage and notes

TODAY PRIORITIES (top of day):
- Clear overdue vendor invoices that block engineers (see queue). T1: DataSense (INV-1842).
- Finish contract redline for Acme Integrations (clauses: auto-renew, termination for convenience, data residency). Need to send draft to legal by EOD.
- Flag upcoming SaaS renewals > $10k next 60d and confirm owner / PO.

INVOICE QUEUE (quick checks):
1) DataSense - INV-1842 - $14,720.00 - due 2026-03-15 - PO matched? YES (PO-903). Approver: SRE lead (R. Sen). Payment: ACH ready. Note: vendor chasing for early payment discount (2%). Check bank cutoff for ACH today.
2) OmniMetrics - INV-1999 - $2,400.00 - due 2026-03-20 - PO missing. Action: ping PM (Ava) to confirm SOW link and create PO. Ticket: JIRA-INV-4821.
3) RackLine - INV-1710 - $48,300.00 - due 2026-04-01 - Dedicated infra spend, reserved capacity. Payment hold: procurement requested revised invoice with taxBreakdown. Email sent 2026-03-10, awaiting reply.
4) Freelancer (contractor) - expense report - $1,200 - reimb. Due now. Confirm timesheet in Deel.

NOTES / QUICK CHECKS:
- If invoice >$25k, needs finance director sign-off (policy v2). RackLine borderline: escalate to finance director? Put on weekly sync agenda.
- Ensure DataSense discount applies before release of payment (2% early pay). If we miss same-day ACH, capture next-day and note discount lost.

CONTRACT REDLINE: Acme Integrations (SaaS connector) - draft v0.3
- Key asks to add/remove (my shorthand):
  * Auto-renew: change from "automatic" 12-month renew to "renewal requires 60 days written notice prior to term end" (redline in clause 5).
  * Termination for convenience: add 30-day right with pro-rata refund on committed capacity.
  * Data residency: add data processing addendum - prefer EU-only for EU customers, otherwise default US. Add KMS/HSM mention per Private deployment requirements.
  * Indemnity: limit Redwood liability to fees paid in prior 12 months (propose cap). Legal: check precedents (CONF-DR-9876).
  * SLA credits: explicit SLA, credit schedule for >200ms p95 breaches. Product to confirm target.
  * Assignment: add clause that assignment requires notice but not consent for acquisitions.
  * Governing law: prefer CA; vendor wants DE. Note: escalate if they insist on non-US governing law.
- Open questions for legal:
  * Acceptable a) mutual indemnity vs b) vendor-only? I prefer mutual but limited.
  * Data deletion window on termination: propose 30 days.
  * Subprocessor list: ask for current list + 30-day advance notice for new subs.
- Next steps: apply redlines in Google Doc, send to legal (R. Sen) for formal review, then to counterparty. Add comment tags: @legal-review, @ops-config.

RENEWAL TRACKER (60d view) - quick triage: 
- SentryCloud (observability) - auto-renews 2026-04-20 - $18,400/yr - owner: infra team - action: confirm whether to keep full retention plan or scale down to reduce cost. Put on Ops agenda 2026-03-18.
- DocuSign - 2026-05-10 - $9,600/yr - action: check negotiated discount (legacy). Contact: procurement.
- Postman (team) - 2026-03-30 - small seat-based - owner: devx - confirm headcount before renewal.

REMINDERS / TODOS (short):
- [ ] Send Acme v0.3 redline to legal (tag @Rohit) - EOD
- [ ] Approve DataSense payment if bank cutoff met - today 16:00 PT
- [ ] Create PO for OmniMetrics + confirm SOW link - ping Ava
- [ ] Follow up RackLine tax breakdown - cc procurement
- [ ] Upload contractor timesheet & release reimbursement
- [ ] Add RackLine approval to weekly finance sync agenda

LOG / COMMUNICATIONS:
- 2026-03-09: Received RackLine revised invoice request (email thread in Gmail).
- 2026-03-10: Sent OmniMetrics request for SOW link to PM (Ava).
- 2026-03-11: Legal initial review note on Acme: focus on clause 7 (indemnity) and clause 12 (confidentiality).

NOTES TO SELF / LOOSE IDEAS:
- Consider adding a simple approvals matrix doc for invoices <25k vs >25k to reduce back-and-forth. Maybe a short Google Sheet (template).
- Track early-pay discounts separately to surface cost-savings to finance ops. Could be a small weekly digest.

UNRESOLVED / BLOCKERS:
- OmniMetrics PO missing -> blocks payment scheduling.
- RackLine tax breakdown -> blocks release until finance director decision (possible hold).

END-OF-DAY CHECK (to fill):
- Payments processed: (list)
- Redlines complete: (yes/no)
- Tickets updated: (JIRA IDs)

Misc: quick links - Invoice checklist doc: gdoc:1a2B3cInvoiceChecklist | Legal redline guidelines: CONF-DR-9876 | Procurement playbook: gdoc:procure-playbook-2025

(Freeform notes, messy — come back tomorrow to tidy up)
